evidence.notes: AccessLevel overloads run through local DML and return SaveResult shape.
Single-record insert with allOrNone and AccessLevel returns local SaveResult shape.
Single-record insert with typed AccessLevel returns local SaveResult shape.
AccessLevel overloads run through local DML and return SaveResult shape.
Single-record update with AccessLevel returns local SaveResult shape.
External-ID and mode-only AccessLevel overloads run through local DML and return UpsertResult shape.
External-ID upsert with allOrNone and AccessLevel returns local UpsertResult shape.
Mode-only upsert with typed AccessLevel returns local UpsertResult shape.
AccessLevel overloads run through local DML and return DeleteResult shape.

AccessLevel overloads run through local DML and return UndeleteResult shape.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseDmlAccessLevelTest { @isTest static void accessLevelOverloadsRunLocalDml() { Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Acme'), true, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult insertedSystem = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'System Acme'), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(insertedSystem.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult updatedUser = Database.update(new Account(Id = insertedSystem.getId(), Name = 'System Changed'), AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(updatedUser.isSuccess()); Account upserted = new Account(Name = 'Upserted', Other_Key__c = 'ext-access'); Database.UpsertResult upsertResult = Database.upsert(upserted, Account.Other_Key__c, false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(upsertResult.isSuccess()); Account modeOnly = new Account(Name = 'Mode Only', Other_Key__c = 'ext-mode-only'); Database.UpsertResult modeOnlyResult = Database.upsert(modeOnly, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(modeOnlyResult.isSuccess()); Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(new Account(Id = inserted.getId()), false, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult undeleted = Database.undelete(new Account(Id = inserted.getId()), false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(undeleted.isSuccess()); Account mergeMaster = new Account(Name = 'Merge Master'); insert mergeMaster; Account mergeDuplicate = new Account(Name = 'Merge Duplicate'); insert mergeDuplicate; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(new Account(Id = mergeMaster.Id, Name = 'Merged Master'), mergeDuplicate.Id, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assert(merged.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(mergeMaster.Id, merged.getId()); System.assertEquals(mergeDuplicate.Id, merged.getMergedRecordIds().get(0)); } }
